## average_interest_rates

Monthly average interest rates on outstanding Treasury securities; values are percentages, not fractions. Returns typed columns record_date, security_type_desc, security_desc, avg_interest_rate_amt, src_line_nbr, record_fiscal_year, record_fiscal_quarter, record_calendar_year, record_calendar_quarter, record_calendar_month, record_calendar_day, source_json, amount_units. The public upstream API needs no key. Amounts retain source scales; original source strings remain available in JSON. NULL arguments are rejected. Missing optional response fields return NULL. Upstream errors fail the query; SQL WHERE filters are local.
